info.name: Pokedex API — by User Story
info.description:
Pokemon Clean Architecture API (Ballast Lane), organized by user story like docs/api_doc.html. Each story folder shows BOTH the external PokeAPI endpoints it consumes (with params) AND our own endpoint.

HOW TO USE:
1. Run '0. Auth (run first) > Login (admin)' — it auto-saves the JWT into {{token}}.
2. Then explore any user story. '[PokeAPI]' requests hit the public PokeAPI; '[Our API]' requests hit our service.

Seeded credentials: admin / admin123.
Variables: {{baseUrl}}=http://localhost:8080 , {{pokeapi}}=https://pokeapi.co/api/v2

item.name: 0. Auth (run first)
item.description: Auxiliary Users/Auth API. Read routes are public; write routes need the Bearer token from Login.

item.name: User Story 01 — Pokemon Enumeration
item.description: Browse Pokemon via paginated results showing sprite, category, mass and skills. Needs 3 PokeAPI endpoints (list + detail + species), exposed by our GET /api/pokemon.

request.description: US01 'paginated results'. Returns only name + url per Pokemon (N+1 → justifies caching). Params: limit, offset.
US01 'sprite, mass, skills'. sprite → sprites.front_default; mass → weight (hectograms ÷10=kg); skills → abilities[].ability.name.
US01 'category'. category → genera[] filtered by language.name == 'en' → .genus (e.g. 'Seed Pokemon'). Not present in /pokemon/{id}.
Our endpoint that returns the enumeration (sprite, category, weight, abilities) from the local DB. Public.

item.name: User Story 02 — Detailed View
item.description: Full data for one Pokemon: image, core statistics, narrative description and evolutionary lineage. Needs 3 PokeAPI endpoints (detail + species + evolution-chain), exposed by our GET /api/pokemon/{id}.

request.description: US02 'image, core statistics'. image → sprites.other.official-artwork.front_default; core statistics → stats[].base_stat + stats[].stat.name.
US02 'narrative description'. description → flavor_text_entries[] filtered by language.name == 'en' (strip \n and \f).
US02 'evolutionary lineage'. Recursive: walk chain.evolves_to[] (bulbasaur → ivysaur → venusaur).
Our endpoint returning image, stats, description, evolutions and proprietary fields from the local DB. Public.

item.name: User Story 03 — Data Synchronization
item.description: Replicate Pokemon from the PokeAPI into the local DB (keeps proprietary fields). No new external endpoint — it reuses the US01/US02 PokeAPI endpoints internally. Our endpoint: POST /api/pokemon/sync (protected).

request.description: PROTECTED (run Login first). Body {limit, offset}. Returns {synced, created, updated, items}.

item.name: User Story 04 — Local Data Modification
item.description: Update / delete a stored Pokemon with validation (404 if missing, 400 if invalid payload). Our endpoints: PUT and DELETE /api/pokemon/{id} (protected).

request.description: Updates localizedName / region / internalTags on the local record. Returns 200 with the updated resource.
Valid payload against a non-existent id → 404 Not Found.
Empty localizedName fails bean validation → 400 Bad Request.
Removes the local record. 204 No Content, or 404 if it does not exist.
